questions: When the price of something changes, do you want to be able to change it on the list? If so, should the old price be kept so you can look back at it?
Do some things come in different sizes or packs with different prices (for example one tin versus a carton, or a sachet versus a bag)? Should each one be its own line on the list?
When you look up a price, will you type the full name of the item? Or should typing part of the name (like "milk") show every item that matches?
answers: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
